pages.intro: The riser is the weapon's core: durability and accuracy.
pages.outro: $(br2)$(l)Copper$() and $(l)Iron$() are the metal risers, the only ones stiff enough to carry a high-tension string.$(br2)$(l)Conductive$(): during a thunderstorm, a hit calls lightning.
$(br2)$(l)Flax$() is farmable and renewable, so it trades power for convenience. $(l)Shaky$(): holding a full draw too long jitters your aim.
